caption: The drawing depicts a single column-like structure standing on a rectangular base. The column is vertically fluted and tapers upward, with a decorative, rounded base that transitions into the flat surface of the base platform. On top of the column, there is a shallow, square-shaped dish or basin with sloped sides. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray, consistent with pencil or graphite on a light, tan-colored paper. Near the bottom left corner of the image, there is a smaller inset line drawing, showing a simplified, frontal outline of the same object. The main object is centrally positioned, occupying the majority of the composition, while the inset sketch sits in a small rectangle at the left edge. The overall look is monochromatic with minimal shading, highlighting the form and structure of the column and base.
